meta.purpose: Track actions, propagate effects through time and space, surface unexpected results

distance_decay.foreign: other continent, rumor only unless major
distance_decay.planar: other planes, symbolic or magical only

ripple_generation.step_1: Identify all connection_web nodes within range of target
ripple_generation.step_2: For each path (social, economic, magical, ecological, narrative), check if action could propagate
ripple_generation.step_3: Roll time_delay based on path (social fast, ecological slow)
ripple_generation.step_5: Generate consequence_event, schedule for future session
ripple_generation.step_6: If consequence affects PC backstory element, flag for revelation

examples: The faction you spared offers alliance
The item you returned unlocks hidden power
The NPC you saved appears with vital information
The reputation you earned opens forbidden door
The enemy you humiliated seeks revenge
The secret you revealed triggers witch hunt
The place you desecrated becomes cursed
The ally you betrayed leads ambush
The region you liberated becomes prosperous (new problems)
The faction you destroyed is replaced by worse
The power you used changes you (corruption, enlightenment)
The vow you completed leaves you hollow
The NPC you trusted reveals your secret to enemy
The place you visited mirrors your wound
The item you carry whispers your true name
The enemy you killed was your unknown sibling

tracking.kindness: mercy to enemies, aid to strangers, restoration
tracking.principle: keeping vows, upholding ideals, accepting cost

accumulation.method: tally with context, not raw count
accumulation.example: Sparing 10 bandits: +kindness. Sparing the bandit who killed your sister: +principle, +kindness, potential -vow_progress

endings.cruel_domination: You rule through fear. The world is orderly. You are alone.
endings.kindred_salvation: You saved them all. The cost was you. They remember, mostly.
endings.pragmatic_survival: You endured. Others fell. The world continues, indifferent.
endings.principled_sacrifice: You kept your word. The ending was bitter. You do not regret.
endings.corrupted_victory: You won. You are what you fought. The next hero comes for you.
endings.unexpected_redemption: You failed, then tried again. The world forgives slowly. You live.

for_ai_dm: What consequences are due this session?
What opportunities can I offer based on past actions?
What threats should emerge from PC history?
What moral weight trends suggest which ending?
What revelation is optimally timed now?
